title: Prismatic Instance
description: An instance is a deployment of an integration to a specific customer, with customer-specific configuration values.

enabled.description: Whether the instance is currently enabled and running

deployed.description: Whether the instance has been deployed

needsDeploy.description: Whether the instance needs to be redeployed after configuration changes

customer.description: The customer this instance is deployed to

integration.description: The integration this instance is based on

configVariables.description: Configuration variables specific to this instance

apiEndpointUrl.description: Webhook endpoint URL for the flow

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the instance was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the instance was last updated
